headings.text: JLCPCB at IMTS 2026: Powering End-to-End Electronics and Mechanical Innovation
Discover the JLC Integrated Manufacturing Platform

meta_description: JLCPCB will attend IMTS 2026 in Chicago from September 14–19. Visit Booth #432271 to explore integrated electronics, 3D printing, CNC, and automation solutions.
monitored_text: Home Newsroom JLCPCB at IMTS 2026: Powering End-to-End Electronics and Mechanical Innovation JLCPCB at IMTS 2026: Powering End-to-End Electronics and Mechanical Innovation Press Release Sep 09, 2026 Table of Contents About IMTS 2026 JLCPCB at IMTS 2026 Pre-Register & Visit Perks Discover the JLC Integrated Manufacturing Platform About JLC Technology Group As the manufacturing world gathers in Chicago for IMTS 2026 , we are excited to announce our participation at Booth #432271 in the West Building, Level 3 . From September 14 to 19, we invite engineers, designers, and industry leaders to discover how our integrated platform connects electronics design, manufacturing, and mechanical production in one seamless workflow. About IMTS 2026 The International Manufacturing Technology Show (IMTS) is the premier manufacturing technology event in the Western Hemisphere. IMTS 2026 brings together manufacturers, engineers, technology providers, and industry leaders from across the manufacturing sector, showcasing the latest advances in metalworking, additive manufacturing, automation, inspection, and digital manufacturing. JLCPCB at IMTS 2026 Date: September 14–19, 2026 Booth: #432271 | West Building, Level 3 Venue: McCormick Place Convention Center Address: 2301 S. King Drive, Chicago, IL 60616, USA Pre-Register & Visit Perks To celebrate our participation in IMTS 2026, we are offering exclusive rewards for our visitors and community members: 🎁 Pre-Register Online : Complete the pre-registration survey and get a $10 coupon → https://forms.gle/fyNS43vDrGZ469ds6 🎁 Visit Our Booth : Stop by JLCPCB Booth #432271 to get an additional $15 coupon, an exclusive gift for pre-registered visitors, and other free JLCPCB gifts onsite. 💬 Meet the JLCPCB Team : Connect face-to-face with the JLCPCB team, ask questions, and get insights tailored to your order needs. Discover the JLC Integrated Manufacturing Platform At our booth, visitors will discover how we streamline the entire product development journey—from initial concept to final production—under one digital roof. Our five core business lines work together to accelerate your R&D and reduce time‑to‑market: EasyEDA (PCB Design Software): Design seamlessly with our free, cloud-based EDA tool, with access to over 1 million components JLCPCB (Electronics Manufacturing): Accelerate development with 1–32 layer advanced PCB fabrication, stencils, turnkey SMT assembly, and global component sourcing. JLC3DP (3D Printing Solutions): Rapid, cost-effective industrial 3D printing across SLA, SLS, MJF, FDM, SLM, WJP, and BJ with high-performance plastics, nylons, resins, and metals. JLCCNC (CNC Machining & Sheet Metal): High-precision custom parts on demand, featuring 3- to 5-axis CNC milling, turning, EDM, and complete sheet metal fabrication. JLCMC (Automation Components): A vast marketplace for industrial automation, stocking 1M+ mechanical parts, linear motion components, sensors, motors, and more. About JLC Technology Group Founded in 2006, JLC Technology Group is a leading digital manufacturing platform committed to accelerating global hardware innovation. By seamlessly integrating EDA software, smart automated factories, and a reliable global supply-chain infrastructure, we proudly serve over 9.5 million engineers, businesses, and makers across 180+ countries. Join us this September in Chicago and let's shape the future of hardware together!
